source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 / CERES SYN1deg), daily, point request
resolution: 0.5 x 0.625 degree cell (MERRA-2); not an in-situ station
method: Header stripped; -999 -> NaN; QA flags per row (missing, t_outlier vs 15-day rolling median > 12 C, tmax_lt_tmin, precip_extreme > 150 mm, precip_negative).
qa_note: Full-file check 2026-11-14: no -999 and no t_max < t_min; monthly means for May-Aug 2023 (18-25 C) are consistent with central Iowa climatology, so the suspected summer cold artefact was not confirmed. t_outlier is a heuristic flag (|t_mean - 15-day rolling median| > 12 C) and can mark genuine cold snaps; flagged days are kept unchanged and exposed as warnings.
